message.content:
I don’t have access to live weather feeds right now, so I can’t tell you exactly what it’s doing at this moment. However:

* **Typical London Weather**  
  * Spring (March–May): Mild temperatures ranging from ~8 °C to 15 °C; rain showers common.  
  * Summer (June–August): Warmest period – usually 16 °C‑25 °C, though heatwaves can push above 30 °C on rare occasions.  
  * Autumn (September–November): Cooling down again, often 10 °C‑17 °C, with frequent overcast skies.  
  * Winter (December–February): Cool to cold, average highs around 5 °C‑7 °C; occasional snow/ice events.

If you want up-to-date conditions—temperature, precipitation chance, wind speed, UV index—you’ll get the most accurate picture from services such as:
- [Met Office](https://www.metoffice.gov.uk/)
- BBC Weather
- AccuWeather / Weather.com
- Your local news station’s website

Just type “London weather” into your favorite search engine or open one of those apps, and you’ll see the latest forecast plus hourly updates.
